goal: Generate a 2×2 seasonal beverage banner set, overall 1:1, in a Starbucks-style green palette, with primarily Chinese text.

brand.name: Starbucks · Seasonal Special Drinks 2026
brand.logo_position: Each grid has a green circular mermaid simplified emblem + logo at the top left

panels.headline: Cherry blossom white peach latte returns.
panels.visual: Pink-white gradient drink cup, petals and wooden table with shallow depth of field, morning light from the side window

panels.headline: Lime cold brew, bubbles awaken the afternoon
panels.visual: Glass goblet, ice cubes and lime slices, close-up of condensation droplets

panels.headline: Maple Sugar Fluffy Cloud Latte
panels.visual: Amber milk foam surface with maple sugar pattern, warm autumn leaves blurred background, holding the cup

panels.headline: Roasted tea rice milk, warm and easy on the stomach
panels.visual: Terracotta color paper cup, steam, scarf and initially snowy street view with soft focus

style.art_style: Warm food photography feel + slight grain + high saturation but not excessive
style.typography: Chinese rounded title + English small subtitle, with a unified CTA green outlined white core button.

must_keep: Four sections with the same green primary color and dark brown secondary color
Each grid has a clear main beverage, not obscured by text
avoid: The color temperature differences in each box are large enough to resemble four brands
Text should not be stacked irrationally than the main area of the beverage.
